messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The maximum achievable minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square equals 1/144, attained by placing all 13 points on the boundary of the square: specifically at the four corners, the midpoints of all four sides, and the five points that divide one pair of opposite sides into thirds (two on one side, two on the other, plus one additional boundary point). This boundary-only configuration is optimal because any interior point can be displaced toward the nearest boundary without decreasing the minimum triangle area, since every triangle containing that point gains area as its third vertex moves away from the line through the other two."}
